import shutil
import subprocess
import tempfile
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path
FIRMWARE_DIR = Path('/var/lib/smarthub/firmware')
LOCK_DIR = Path('/var/lock')

@contextmanager
def _device_lock(device_id):
    lock = LOCK_DIR / f'smarthub-{device_id}.lock'
    lock.touch(exist_ok=False)
    try:
        yield lock
    finally:
        lock.unlink(missing_ok=True)

def install_device_firmware_update(device_id: str, firmware_path: str, flash_tool: str='/usr/local/bin/flash_device') -> dict:
    src = Path(firmware_path)
    if not src.is_file():
        return {'error': 'firmware file not found'}
    target_dir = FIRMWARE_DIR / device_id
    target_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = target_dir / src.name
    with _device_lock(device_id):
        shutil.move(str(src), str(dest))
        # Make the staged firmware read-only for the owner and group, no access for others
        dest.chmod(0o440)
        target_dir.chmod(0o750)
        with tempfile.TemporaryFile(mode='w+') as out:
            proc = subprocess.run([flash_tool, '--device', device_id, '--image', str(dest)], stdout=out, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=600)
            out.seek(0)
            log_tail = out.read()[-1000:]
    return {'device_id': device_id, 'firmware': str(dest), 'exit_code': proc.returncode, 'log_tail': log_tail}
